benchmark_scope: Small purpose-built 12-query evaluation set (10 answerable, 2 intentionally unanswerable). Results are portfolio regression metrics, not production-wide performance claims.

versions.note: Baseline full pipeline exposed weak citation coverage and unreliable abstention.
Retrieval-confidence gate improved abstention and latency, but model-emitted citations remained unreliable.
Added deterministic source assignment and citation-aware grounding evaluation.
